name: Benjamin Black
caption: The chairman of the fed: the multimillionaire the fed's own column says bought the promotion for $6.5 million, whose Scoop columnist describes him as a face wrestler earlier in his career.

tenures.source: Named as the buyer of the company in the fed's From the Underground column of 25 June 2009 and in its Scoop column of the same day; his roster card is printed with the title Chairman.

name: Anderson Shuman
caption: A member of the fed's staff and the byline on its first From the Underground column, 'The Wrestling World Says Hello to CUW', of 25 June 2009.

tenures.source: Bylined on the fed's From the Underground column of 25 June 2009; his roster card sits under Staff.

name: Scoop Ellison
caption: The fed's analyst and columnist: a former wrestling journalist who says he was fired from his last outlet and hired by the chairman, and who wrote the fed's first Scoop column.

tenures.source: Narrates the fed's Scoop column of 25 June 2009 (in which Benjamin Black calls him 'Ellison' and he signs off as 'Scoop Baby E'); his roster card, printed 'Scoop Ellison', sits under Staff.

name: Dante Davis
caption: One of the two wrestlers the fed's roster page lists under Superstars; the page carries only his card.

tenures.source: Its roster page (roster.html) is pictures only: nine trading-card images, each printed with the character's name, under the headings Superstars and Staff; the name is read from the card.
